Beyond interactive chat, PraisonAIUI exposes automation and integration APIs so external tools, scripts and multi-agent pipelines can drive your agents directly.

Define, trigger and inspect multi-step agent workflows over REST: GET /api/workflows / POST /api/workflows — List or create workflow definitions POST /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/run — Execute a workflow GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/status — Inspect workflow state GET /api/workflows/runs / GET /api/workflows/runs/{run_id} — Review run history and outputs

Register server-side hooks to react to platform events and inspect execution history: GET /api/hooks / POST /api/hooks — List or register hooks POST /api/hooks/{hook_id}/trigger — Trigger a hook manually GET /api/hooks/log — Inspect recent hook invocations

Call your registered PraisonAIUI agents from any OpenAI-compatible client, SDK, or editor using the built-in api plugin (see the API page in the dashboard for ready-to-copy curl/SDK snippets and authentication headers). All requests honor the server's active auth middleware (R8).
